one_line: Poet, nationalist leader and civil disobedience commander at Dharasana during the 1930 Salt Satyagraha.

appearance.age_look: Mid-50s, small but sturdy build with dignified posture.
appearance.face: Rounded face with soft jawline, medium-brown complexion, prominent expressive eyes with faint crow’s feet, slightly broad nose, full lips; default expression a calm, resolute half-smile that can harden into firm determination.
appearance.hair: Dark grey hair pulled back neatly into a low bun at the nape of the neck, center parting, a few short wisps at the temples; covered by a white khadi sari pallu drawn over the head like a modest hood.
appearance.costume: Handspun khadi sari in plain off‑white with a narrow deep‑blue woven border, draped in a simple Gujarati style with the pallu coming from the back over the left shoulder and lightly covering her head; beneath, a modest elbow‑length blouse in muted indigo; she wears a lightweight, long‑sleeved, off‑white khadi chadar folded around her shoulders when needed; simple leather sandals on her feet; minimal jewellery—small round silver stud earrings, a thin silver chain with a tiny circular locket, and a plain silver bangle on her right wrist, all understated to emphasize austerity and discipline of satyagraha; a plain cotton cloth bag hangs diagonally from left shoulder to right hip.
appearance.signature: A rolled khadi protest banner staff—essentially a slender wooden pole about her height with a neatly rolled plain off‑white cloth banner attached, carried in her right hand like a walking staff to symbolize leadership and nonviolent protest.

ref_desc: Sarojini Naidu is a mid‑50s, medium‑brown woman with a rounded face, grey hair in a low bun under a white khadi sari pallu, wearing an off‑white khadi sari with deep‑blue border, indigo blouse, simple silver jewellery and sandals, carrying a slender wooden staff with a rolled off‑white banner.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character model of Sarojini Naidu in 1930: a mid‑50s, small but sturdy Indian woman with a rounded face, medium‑brown complexion, expressive eyes and calm, resolute expression; her dark grey hair is parted in the center and tied into a low bun at the nape, with a white khadi sari pallu draped over her head like a modest hood. She wears an off‑white handspun khadi sari with a narrow deep‑blue woven border, draped in a simple Gujarati style with the pallu coming from the back over her left shoulder and covering part of her head, over a modest elbow‑length indigo blouse; a lightweight, long‑sleeved off‑white khadi chadar can be seen folded around her shoulders. Show simple leather sandals on her feet, a plain cotton cloth bag slung diagonally from left shoulder to right hip, and minimal jewellery: small round silver stud earrings, a thin silver chain with a tiny circular locket, and a plain silver bangle on her right wrist. In her right hand she holds her signature item, a slender wooden staff about her height with a neatly rolled off‑white cloth protest banner attached near the top, symbolizing leadership and nonviolent protest. Use a restrained palette of off‑white, deep blue, indigo, silver and medium brown, and present her in a neutral standing pose with front, side and three‑quarter views to emphasize her consistent face, hair, sari drape, and staff as a recurring design.
